summary: Enter Ranni's service and recover the Fingerslayer Blade, slay the Baleful Shadow, and place the Dark Moon Ring on her doll to gain the Dark Moon Greatsword and unlock the Age of the Stars ending.
reward: Dark Moon Greatsword, Carian Inverted Statue, Discarded Palace Key, Age of the Stars ending

steps.title: Meet 'Renna' at the Church of Elleh
steps.detail: After meeting Melina and acquiring Torrent, rest at the Church of Elleh and speak with the woman calling herself Renna, who gifts you a means of summoning spirits.

steps.title: Reach the top of Ranni's Rise
steps.detail: Defeat Royal Knight Loretta at Caria Manor to open the way, then travel through the Three Sisters to the top of Ranni's Rise.
steps.warning: Do not activate the Grand Lift of Dectus or rest at Altus Plateau graces first, as that triggers the Radahn Festival and temporarily locks the questline.

steps.title: Agree to serve Ranni
steps.detail: Speak with Ranni atop her tower and answer affirmatively to enter her service.
steps.warning: If she dismisses you, return to Rogier at Roundtable Hold and have him suggest you join her service, then come back.

steps.title: Speak with her three servants
steps.detail: Inside the tower, exhaust all dialogue with the spectral projections of War Counselor Iji, Blaidd, and Preceptor Seluvis; a fog wall blocks exit until all three are addressed.
steps.warning: You cannot leave or fast-travel until all three servants are spoken to.

steps.title: Meet Blaidd at Siofra River
steps.detail: Travel to Siofra River Bank and head east to find Blaidd near a Spirit Spring; speak with him to be directed onward to Seluvis.

steps.title: Consult Preceptor Seluvis
steps.detail: Visit Seluvis at Seluvis's Rise; he gives you an introduction to take to Sorceress Sellen.
steps.warning: Do not kill Seluvis before finishing his branch, or Ranni's questline becomes inaccessible.

steps.title: Show Seluvis's Introduction to Sorceress Sellen
steps.detail: Travel to Waypoint Ruins and present Seluvis's Introduction to Sorceress Sellen, who reveals that Starscourge Radahn is holding the stars in place.
steps.warning: Telling Blaidd of Sellen's findings can trigger the Radahn Festival.

steps.title: Defeat Starscourge Radahn at the Festival
steps.detail: Travel to Redmane Castle in Caelid and join the Radahn Festival to battle Starscourge Radahn in the Wailing Dunes.
steps.warning: The festival is triggered by reaching the Altus Plateau, using the Grand Lift of Dectus, or informing Blaidd about Radahn.

steps.title: Find the Nokron entrance south of Mistwood
steps.detail: Return to War Counselor Iji, who explains a fallen star struck Limgrave; travel south of Mistwood to the impact site with the suspended rocks.

steps.title: Retrieve the Fingerslayer Blade in Nokron
steps.detail: Descend through Nokron, Eternal City via the falling-star debris, pass the Ancestral Woods, and loot the Fingerslayer Blade from a chest in the city.

steps.title: Give the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni
steps.detail: Return to Ranni's Rise and hand Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade; she rewards you and departs on her journey.
steps.warning: Giving the blade locks you out of Seluvis's quest if unfinished; do not give Seluvis's Amber Draught to Ranni after this point.

steps.title: Invert the Divine Tower of Liurnia
steps.detail: Use the Carian Inverted Statue at the Carian Study Hall entrance to flip the tower, climb to the top, and loot the Cursemark of Death from Ranni's burnt body.

steps.title: Loot the Snow Witch Set at Renna's Rise
steps.detail: With the seal gone, enter Renna's Rise, take the Snow Witch Set from the chest at the top, and use the waygate to travel to Ainsel River Main.

steps.title: Pick up the Miniature Ranni
steps.detail: At Ainsel River Main, collect the Miniature Ranni doll from the ground and rest at the Site of Grace.

steps.title: Talk to the Miniature Ranni three times
steps.detail: At the Ainsel River Main grace, select 'Talk to miniature Ranni' three separate times until she tasks you with slaying the Baleful Shadow.
steps.warning: She only responds fully after the third time talking to her.

steps.title: Defeat the Baleful Shadow
steps.detail: Travel to Nokstella, Eternal City, go beyond the Nokstella Waterfall Basin grace, and defeat the Baleful Shadow that ambushes you.

steps.title: Open the chest for the Dark Moon Ring
steps.detail: Use the Discarded Palace Key on the chest beside Rennala in Raya Lucaria Academy's Grand Library to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.

steps.title: Reach the Grand Cloister via the Lake of Rot
steps.detail: Travel through the Lake of Rot into the Grand Cloister and interact with the stone coffin from a distance to begin the boss encounter.
steps.warning: Avoid standing in the Scarlet Rot water of the Lake of Rot.

steps.title: Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
steps.detail: After entering the coffin, battle and defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void in the arena beyond the Grand Cloister.

steps.title: Reach the Cathedral of Manus Celes
steps.detail: Proceed from the defeated Astel up to the Moonlight Altar in southern Liurnia and enter the Cathedral of Manus Celes, then drop through the hole near the grace to find Ranni's doll body.
steps.warning: Glintstone Dragon Adula appears near the cathedral regardless of prior encounters.

steps.title: Place the Dark Moon Ring on Ranni
steps.detail: Interact with Ranni's doll body in the lower chamber and place the Dark Moon Ring on her finger; she awakens and rewards you with her greatsword.

steps.title: Choose the Age of the Stars ending
steps.detail: After defeating the Elden Beast at the game's finale, interact with the blue summon sign near Marika's remains instead of Marika's body to trigger the Age of the Stars ending.
steps.warning: Choosing this sign locks you into the Age of the Stars ending for this playthrough.

summary: Aid Ranni's half-wolf shadow Blaidd from the Darriwil bounty through the Radahn Festival until he turns hostile at Ranni's Rise, where defeating him yields the Royal Greatsword and his armor set.
reward: Royal Greatsword, Blaidd's Armor, Blaidd's Gauntlets, Blaidd's Greaves

steps.title: Learn the Finger Snap from Kalé
steps.detail: Hearing wolf howls in Mistwood, ask Merchant Kalé about the howling at the Church of Elleh to receive the Finger Snap gesture.

steps.title: Summon Blaidd at Mistwood Ruins
steps.detail: Stand below the tallest point of the Mistwood Ruins where Blaidd rests and perform the Finger Snap gesture to bring him down to talk.

steps.title: Defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil
steps.detail: Travel to the Forlorn Hound Evergaol and fight Bloodhound Knight Darriwil; Blaidd is available as a summon for the bounty.

steps.title: Speak with Blaidd after the bounty
steps.detail: Talk to Blaidd twice after the fight; the first conversation rewards a smithing stone and the second points you to the blacksmith Iji.
steps.warning: Talk to him before progressing Ranni's questline further or the smithing stone is forfeit.

steps.title: Tell Iji that Blaidd sent you
steps.detail: Travel to the Road to the Manor in Liurnia and tell War Counselor Iji that Blaidd sent you, unlocking the Carian Filigreed Crest in his shop.
steps.warning: Missable if you never mention Blaidd to Iji.

steps.title: Meet Blaidd at Siofra River
steps.detail: While following Ranni's quest, reach Siofra River Bank and speak with Blaidd east of the grace; he directs you to Preceptor Seluvis.

steps.title: Report back to Blaidd about Radahn
steps.detail: After consulting Seluvis and Sorceress Sellen, return to Blaidd at Siofra River; he tells you of the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle.

steps.title: Fight Starscourge Radahn with Blaidd
steps.detail: Travel to Redmane Castle, join the Radahn Festival, and summon Blaidd to help defeat Starscourge Radahn in the Wailing Dunes.

steps.title: Speak with Blaidd after Radahn
steps.detail: Talk to Blaidd next to the Starscourge Radahn Site of Grace in the Wailing Dunes for post-fight dialogue.

steps.title: Defeat Astel to advance the quest
steps.detail: Continue Ranni's questline through the Lake of Rot and defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, which sets up Blaidd's final state.

steps.title: Defeat the hostile Blaidd at Ranni's Rise
steps.detail: Return to Ranni's Rise after defeating Astel to find Blaidd turned hostile outside the tower; defeat him to claim his weapon, armor, and runes.
steps.warning: This fight is unavoidable to complete the quest; the Black Wolf Mask is collected separately near Seluvis's Rise rather than dropped here.

steps.title: Collect the Black Wolf Mask near Seluvis's Rise
steps.detail: After defeating Blaidd, travel to Seluvis's Rise to pick up the Black Wolf Mask lying near the tower, completing his armor set.
steps.warning: The mask is found as an item near the rise, not dropped from Blaidd's body.

summary: Serve the sorcerer Seluvis by administering his potion and gathering Amber Starlight, earning puppet spirit ashes, sorceries, and the Magic Scorpion Charm before he is found dead when Ranni's quest completes.
reward: Magic Scorpion Charm, puppet Spirit Ashes (Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet / Jarwight Puppet), Seluvis's sorceries

steps.title: Meet Seluvis's spectre at Ranni's Rise
steps.detail: After speaking with Ranni for the first time, talk to Seluvis in spectral form inside Ranni's Rise; he asks you to visit him in person.

steps.title: Visit Seluvis's Rise for the potion
steps.detail: Travel to Seluvis's Rise in the Three Sisters and speak with Seluvis in person; he hands you a potion to administer to someone.
steps.warning: Attacking Seluvis permanently locks Ranni's questline; it can only be undone with Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows.

steps.title: Administer Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli Loux
steps.detail: Give Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli Loux to turn her into a puppet (or let Gideon Ofnir dispose of it, or give it to the Dung Eater); her puppet then appears in Seluvis's laboratory.
steps.warning: Only one of the Nepheli or Dung Eater puppets can be obtained per playthrough; letting Gideon discard the potion forfeits both.

steps.title: Find the hidden puppet laboratory
steps.detail: Strike the illusory floor in the ruins between Renna's Rise and Ranni's Rise to reveal Seluvis's secret chamber, guarded by an invisible Noble Sorcerer.
steps.warning: Do this before giving the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni.

steps.title: Receive a free puppet from Seluvis
steps.detail: Return to Seluvis and ask about his chambers to choose one free puppet Spirit Ashes after the potion has been administered.

steps.title: Trade Amber Starlight for the Magic Scorpion Charm
steps.detail: Find the Amber Starlight on the Altus Plateau (located via Pidia's Weathered Map) and give it to Seluvis at his rise to receive the Magic Scorpion Charm.
steps.warning: Must be done before giving the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni.

steps.title: Obtain the Amber Draught (betrayal branch)
steps.detail: Reload the area and speak to Seluvis again to receive the Amber Draught, which he wants you to give to Ranni.
steps.warning: Holding it is safe, but giving the Amber Draught to Ranni makes Ranni, Iji, and Blaidd vanish for no reward; undo only with Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows.

steps.title: Find Seluvis dead after Ranni's quest
steps.detail: Once you give the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni and progress her quest, Seluvis is found dead in his tower; nearby Pidia is also slain by his puppets.

summary: Befriend Ranni's troll war counselor and blacksmith Iji, who unlocks the Carian Filigreed Crest and guides Ranni's quest, until grief over Blaidd's death leaves him dead and dropping his bell bearing and helm.
reward: Carian Filigreed Crest, Iji's Bell Bearing, Iji's Mirrorhelm

steps.title: Meet Smithing Master Iji in Liurnia
steps.detail: Find Iji at his smithing station on the slopes of western Liurnia, past the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore near the Kingsrealm Ruins, where he offers smithing services.

steps.title: Unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest
steps.detail: Tell Iji that Blaidd sent you to add the Carian Filigreed Crest talisman to his shop, then purchase it for 5,000 Runes.
steps.warning: The crest is only unlocked by mentioning Blaidd during his questline.

steps.title: Speak with Iji's spectre at Ranni's Rise
steps.detail: After agreeing to serve Ranni, speak with Iji in spectral form on the first floor of Ranni's Rise as one of her three servants.

steps.title: Defeat Starscourge Radahn
steps.detail: Progress Ranni's quest by defeating Starscourge Radahn at the Redmane Castle festival, which Iji discusses in his dialogue.

steps.title: Hear about the path to Nokron
steps.detail: After Radahn's defeat, return to Iji, who explains that a fallen star opened the way to Nokron, the Eternal City.

steps.title: Tell Iji of Blaidd's death
steps.detail: After defeating the hostile Blaidd, speak to Iji and select the 'Blaidd's Death' dialogue option; he mourns and says he will follow Blaidd soon.
steps.warning: Selecting the 'Blaidd's Death' option triggers his death event.

steps.title: Collect Iji's items after his death
steps.detail: Leave the area and return to find Iji dead and covered in black flame; loot his corpse for his bell bearing and helm.
steps.warning: His death is scripted after the 'Blaidd's Death' dialogue.

summary: Heal the Scarlet Rot-afflicted Millicent with the Unalloyed Gold Needle and aid her against her sisters, culminating in her acceptance of her fate and access to Miquella's Needle at Malenia's arena.
reward: Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom, Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Unalloyed Gold Needle (enables Miquella's Needle + Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone)

steps.title: Start at Gowry's Shack
steps.detail: Speak with Gowry in his shack in eastern Caelid; he asks you to retrieve a broken Unalloyed Gold Needle to heal a girl named Millicent.

steps.title: Defeat Commander O'Neil for the needle
steps.detail: Travel into the Swamp of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil, who drops the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle.

steps.title: Return the needle to Gowry
steps.detail: Give the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle to Gowry and rest at a Site of Grace so he can repair it; he gives you Sellia's Secret.
steps.warning: Reload the area or rest at another grace to trigger the repair.

steps.title: Give the repaired needle to Millicent
steps.detail: Travel to the Church of the Plague atop the cliff beyond Sellia and give the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle to Millicent; rest nearby and exhaust her dialogue to receive the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom.
steps.warning: Reach the church via the Sellia puzzle or a Spirit Spring jump from Dragonbarrow.

steps.title: Meet Millicent on the Altus Plateau
steps.detail: After she relocates and you reload, find Millicent near the cliff edge north-northeast of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace; she asks you to retrieve the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.

steps.title: Retrieve the Valkyrie's Prosthesis
steps.detail: Enter the Shaded Castle and take the Valkyrie's Prosthesis from the chest guarded by a Cleanrot Knight, then return and give it to Millicent.
steps.warning: Revisit Gowry right after delivering the prosthesis to keep his questline (Desperate Prayer gesture) on track.

steps.title: Defeat the Godskin Apostle at Windmill Village
steps.detail: Defeat the Godskin Apostle at Dominula, Windmill Village; Millicent's summon sign is available before the fight. Rest at the Windmill Heights grace afterward and exhaust her dialogue.

steps.title: Follow her to the Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.detail: Find Millicent at the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins grace and exhaust her dialogue; she then departs for Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
steps.location: Ancient Snow Valley Ruins, Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Defeat the Putrid Tree Spirit in Elphael
steps.detail: In Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, defeat the Putrid Tree Spirit near the lake; Millicent's summoning sign then appears on the northwest hill.
steps.warning: Millicent will not progress at Elphael until the Putrid Tree Spirit is defeated.

steps.title: Be summoned to help Millicent fight her sisters
steps.detail: Use her summon sign to enter her world and defeat the four invading sisters - Mary, Maureen, Amy, and Polyanna - to receive the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.
steps.warning: Choosing instead to invade and kill Millicent yields only Millicent's Prosthesis and locks you out of the Unalloyed Gold Needle conclusion.

steps.title: Recover the Unalloyed Gold Needle
steps.detail: Find Millicent sitting by the rotten pool near her summoning sign, exhaust her dialogue, then reload the area to find the Unalloyed Gold Needle on the ground.

steps.title: Use the needle on the Scarlet Aeonia for Miquella's Needle
steps.detail: After defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, use the Unalloyed Gold Needle on the Scarlet Aeonia flower left in her arena to receive Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
steps.location: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree (Malenia's arena)
steps.warning: Requires the Unalloyed Gold Needle from the help-Millicent ending; missed entirely if you challenged her instead.

summary: Aid the sorcerer Gowry in healing and guiding Millicent through the Unalloyed Gold Needle, unlocking his sorceries and ultimately his bell bearing after Millicent's fate is decided.
reward: Glintstone Stars, Night Shard, Night Maiden's Mist, Pest Threads, Desperate Prayer gesture, Flock's Canvas Talisman, Gowry's Bell Bearing

steps.title: Speak with Gowry
steps.detail: Talk to Gowry in his shack in eastern Caelid (before Sellia); he asks for help healing a girl named Millicent and sends you for the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
steps.warning: A patrolling Giant Dog near the shack can kill Gowry if aggroed before you speak with him.

steps.title: Defeat Commander O'Neil and return the needle
steps.detail: Defeat Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia for the broken Unalloyed Gold Needle, then bring it back to Gowry, who gives you Sellia's Secret.

steps.title: Let Gowry repair the needle
steps.detail: Rest at a Site of Grace so Gowry repairs the needle; his shop now stocks Glintstone Stars, Night Shard, and Night Maiden's Mist.

steps.title: Deliver the needle to Millicent
steps.detail: Give the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle to Millicent at the Church of the Plague; afterward Gowry reveals Millicent is his daughter.

steps.title: Progress Millicent until she visits the shack
steps.detail: Continue Millicent's quest until she visits Gowry's Shack and departs; Gowry acknowledges her journey onward.

steps.title: Revisit Gowry after delivering the Prosthesis
steps.detail: After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, return to Gowry; Pest Threads becomes purchasable and exhausting his dialogue grants the Desperate Prayer gesture.
steps.warning: Progressing Millicent's quest past the prosthesis stage before revisiting Gowry can lock out the Desperate Prayer gesture.

steps.title: Return to the shack after the sisters' battle
steps.detail: Once Millicent's quest concludes at Elphael, return to Gowry's Shack to find Gowry dead, leaving behind the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing.
steps.warning: The bell bearing's stock depends on when Gowry dies; kill him too early and Pest Threads will be missing from it.

summary: Become Sellen's apprentice and help the exiled sorceress restore her body and confront Witch-Hunter Jerren, choosing to aid or betray her to decide her fate.
reward: Glintstone Kris, Shard Spiral, Eccentric Set (assist) or Witch's Glintstone Crown, Sellen's Bell Bearing (challenge)

steps.title: Become Sellen's apprentice
steps.detail: Reach Sellen in the hidden Waypoint Ruins Cellar (open by defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head) and choose to learn sorcery to unlock her shop and dialogue.

steps.title: Purchase sorceries to unlock dialogue
steps.detail: Buy at least some sorceries from Sellen to unlock further dialogue about her story.

steps.title: Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur
steps.detail: Travel around Mt. Gelmir to find Primeval Sorcerer Azur north of the Hermit Village and speak with him to learn Comet Azur, then report back to Sellen.

steps.title: Receive the glintstone key from Sellen
steps.detail: Report to Sellen, who explains Radahn must be defeated to free the stars and gives you a glintstone key to reach Master Lusat in Sellia Hideaway.

steps.title: Defeat Starscourge Radahn
steps.detail: Take part in the Radahn Festival and defeat Starscourge Radahn at Redmane Castle to allow the stars to move again.

steps.title: Find Master Lusat
steps.detail: Use Sellen's glintstone key on the barrier in the Sellia Hideaway chasm to reach Master Lusat and learn Stars of Ruin, then report to Sellen for the Starlight Shard.
steps.warning: Can be done now or left until the end of the questline.

steps.title: Meet Sellen at Witchbane Ruins
steps.detail: After defeating Radahn, find the imprisoned Sellen at Witchbane Ruins; she gives you Sellen's Primal Glintstone and explains her body is sealed there.
steps.warning: Attacking Sellen here disables her merchant services until you seek absolution at the Church of Vows.

steps.title: Reset Redmane Castle via Jerren
steps.detail: Speak with Witch-Hunter Jerren in the Redmane Castle throne room and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a grace to respawn the castle's enemies.

steps.title: Find Jerren over Sellen's body
steps.detail: Return to Witchbane Ruins to find Jerren standing over Sellen's body and exhaust his dialogue to advance toward the doll resurrection.

steps.title: Resurrect Sellen in the Three Sisters doll
steps.detail: In the Three Sisters near Ranni's Rise, strike the illusory floor and then the hidden wall to reach the Sellen doll, and insert Sellen's Primal Glintstone to revive her.
steps.location: Three Sisters, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
steps.detail: Defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library to set up the final confrontation with Jerren.
steps.location: Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Assist Sellen against Witch-Hunter Jerren
steps.detail: Use the gold summon sign at the Grand Library entrance to help Sellen defeat Witch-Hunter Jerren; she rewards you with the Glintstone Kris and the Shard Spiral sorcery, and Jerren drops the Eccentric Set.
steps.location: Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: Using the red sign to side with Jerren instead kills Sellen permanently, yielding the Witch's Glintstone Crown and Sellen's Bell Bearing but locking her merchant and Lusat's/Azur's sets.

steps.title: Collect post-quest sets
steps.detail: After Sellen transforms into the School of Graven Mages, the Witch's Glintstone Crown lies beside her, and Azur's Glintstone Set and Lusat's Set can be collected from Azur's and Lusat's original locations.
steps.location: Raya Lucaria Grand Library, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: Lusat's Set can only be acquired after Sellen transforms (the assist-Sellen path).

summary: Help the sorcery student Thops return to Raya Lucaria Academy by giving him a spare Academy Glintstone Key, only to later find his body and inherit his sorcery and staff.
reward: Erudition gesture, Thops's Barrier, Academy Glintstone Staff, Thops's Bell Bearing

steps.title: Meet Thops at the Church of Irith
steps.detail: Speak with Thops at the Church of Irith; he asks for a 10-rune donation, which unlocks his shop selling Glintstone Pebble, Glintstone Arc, and Starlight.
steps.location: Church of Irith, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Hear his wish to return to the Academy
steps.detail: Continue speaking with Thops; he explains he wants to return to Raya Lucaria Academy but needs an Academy Glintstone Key, acknowledging you need your first one yourself.
steps.location: Church of Irith, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Find the second Academy Glintstone Key
steps.detail: Progress through Raya Lucaria Academy and pick up the second Academy Glintstone Key found within the building.
steps.location: Raya Lucaria Academy, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: Only the second key found inside the Academy can be given to Thops; the first one used to enter cannot.

steps.title: Give the key to Thops
steps.detail: Return to the Church of Irith and give Thops the Academy Glintstone Key to receive the Erudition gesture; he then leaves for Raya Lucaria Academy.
steps.location: Church of Irith, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: If Thops dies before receiving the key, the Erudition gesture is unavailable until New Game+.

steps.title: Find Thops's body in the Academy
steps.detail: Progress through Raya Lucaria Academy to find Thops's corpse seated at a desk near the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, holding his bequeathed items.

summary: Help the lady-in-waiting Rya recover her stolen necklace, which leads to a Volcano Manor invitation and the unraveling of her true identity as the serpent Zorayas.
reward: Volcano Manor Invitation, Serpent's Amnion, Daedicar's Woe

steps.title: Meet Rya in Liurnia
steps.detail: Speak with Rya at the pavilion near the Birdseye Telescope, north of Laskyar Ruins, and exhaust her dialogue; she asks you to retrieve her stolen necklace.
steps.location: Pavilion near Birdseye Telescope, north of Laskyar Ruins

steps.title: Recover the necklace from the thief
steps.detail: Go northwest to the Boilprawn Shack and find Blackguard Big Boggart; either buy Rya's Necklace for 1000 runes or kill him (killing locks out his questline).
steps.warning: Defeating Blackguard Big Boggart locks out his questline.

steps.title: Return the necklace
steps.detail: Bring Rya's Necklace back to her at the pavilion; she rewards you and reveals two routes to the Altus Plateau.

steps.title: Meet Rya on the Altus Plateau
steps.detail: Find Rya again on the Altus Plateau (Lux Ruins lower section if you came via the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, or the top of the Grand Lift of Dectus if you took the lift); she teleports you to Volcano Manor.
steps.location: Lux Ruins / top of the Grand Lift of Dectus
steps.warning: She will not spawn at the Altus Plateau if you reached Leyndell via Fia's questline instead.

steps.title: Speak to Rya at Volcano Manor
steps.detail: After joining Volcano Manor, speak with Rya in the manor's main hall.
steps.warning: Joining Volcano Manor without first speaking to Rya in Liurnia prevents access to Blackguard Big Boggart's questline.

steps.title: Complete the first assassination
steps.detail: Carry out the first Volcano Manor contract against Old Knight Istvan; afterward Rya moves to a different room and transforms into her serpent form.

steps.title: Speak to Rya in serpent form
steps.detail: Talk to her in her new room, where she reveals her true name is Zorayas and that she is a serpent.

steps.title: Complete the second assassination
steps.detail: Carry out the second Volcano Manor contract against Rileigh the Idle; afterward Rya returns to human form in the same room.

steps.title: Investigate the secret passage
steps.detail: Enter the illusory wall in the adjacent room, pass through to the Prison Town Church grace, open the doors leaving the church, then return to Zorayas.

steps.title: Ask Tanith about Zorayas' troubles
steps.detail: Speak with Lady Tanith and select the 'Zorayas' troubles' dialogue option, which later opens the path to obtain the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
steps.warning: Required to later receive the Tonic of Forgetfulness from Tanith.

steps.title: Defeat the Godskin Noble for the Serpent's Amnion
steps.detail: Defeat the Godskin Noble at the Temple of Eiglay to obtain the Serpent's Amnion, then deliver it to Zorayas.
steps.warning: Completing all assassination contracts before obtaining the Serpent's Amnion prevents Tanith from giving you the Tonic.

steps.title: Obtain the Tonic of Forgetfulness
steps.detail: Having chosen the 'Zorayas' troubles' option, speak to Tanith again and she provides the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
steps.warning: Requires having selected the 'Zorayas' troubles' dialogue with Tanith earlier.

steps.title: Final meeting in the dungeon alcove
steps.detail: Find Zorayas in the small caged room beside the lava pit before the rope ladder (reached via the wooden elevator near the Temple of Eiglay or by jumping from the temple balcony). Either kill her, leave her, or give the Tonic of Forgetfulness; she ultimately drops Daedicar's Woe.
steps.location: Dungeon alcove beside the lava pit, before the rope ladder
steps.warning: Killing Rykard before speaking to Zorayas in this dungeon room locks you out completely.

summary: Pledge yourself to Lady Tanith at Volcano Manor and carry out her assassination contracts in service of her Lord, Rykard.
reward: Magma Shot, Serpentbone Blade, Taker's Cameo, Consort's Set

steps.title: Join Volcano Manor
steps.detail: Speak with Tanith at the Volcano Manor entrance and accept her offer to join the family; she grants the Drawing-Room Key, unlocking the manor's interior chambers.

steps.title: First contract: Old Knight Istvan
steps.detail: Collect the first Letter from Volcano Manor in the Drawing Room (the room with Rya), invade and defeat Old Knight Istvan at Stormhill near the Divine Bridge, then report back to Tanith for the Magma Shot sorcery.

steps.title: Second contract: Rileigh the Idle
steps.detail: Reload and collect the next letter from Knight Bernahl's room, invade and defeat Rileigh the Idle on the Altus Plateau, then return to Tanith for the Serpentbone Blade.
steps.warning: The second assignment letter will not spawn if Rykard is defeated beforehand.

steps.title: Third contract: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood
steps.detail: Reload and collect the Red Letter from Bernahl's room, invade and defeat Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood in the Mountaintops of the Giants, then return to Tanith for the Taker's Cameo talisman.
steps.warning: Must be completed before defeating Rykard, or the reward appears on the table instead.

steps.title: Meet the Lord
steps.detail: Accept Tanith's invitation in her chamber to meet Lord Rykard; she transports you directly to the grace before his arena, where you fight Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
steps.warning: Complete any unfinished Volcano Manor NPC quests before defeating Rykard, as those NPCs may disappear from the manor afterward.

steps.title: Post-Rykard encounter
steps.detail: Return to Tanith in Volcano Manor; she acknowledges Rykard's defeat and announces her departure, after which she is found feasting on Rykard's corpse in his boss chamber.
steps.location: Volcano Manor, then Rykard's boss arena

steps.title: Optionally kill Tanith
steps.detail: At Rykard's corpse, Tanith can be killed to obtain the Consort's Set; doing so triggers an invasion by Tanith's Knight, who drops the Aspect of the Crucible: Breath incantation.
steps.warning: She remains at Rykard's corpse through the game's end; killing her is irreversible.

summary: The warrior Bernahl sells Ashes of War at the Warmaster's Shack before joining Volcano Manor as Recusant Bernahl, eventually turning hostile and invading in Crumbling Farum Azula.
reward: Eruption, Assassin's Gambit, Gelmir's Fury, Devourer's Scepter, Beast Champion Set

steps.title: Meet Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack
steps.detail: Speak with Knight Bernahl at the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill, Limgrave, to access his Ashes of War shop (Kick, Endure, Parry, Quickstep).

steps.title: Join Volcano Manor
steps.detail: Pledge allegiance to Volcano Manor; Bernahl relocates there as 'Recusant Bernahl' and his shop unlocks the Eruption and Assassin's Gambit Ashes of War.

steps.title: Complete the first assassination
steps.detail: Complete the first Volcano Manor assassination contract, then return to speak with Recusant Bernahl.

steps.title: Complete the second assassination and receive his letter
steps.detail: Complete the second Volcano Manor contract and report back; Bernahl gives the Letter to Bernahl, naming two targets for a co-op invasion in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

steps.title: Co-op invasion in Leyndell
steps.detail: Travel to Leyndell, Royal Capital and defeat Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm for the Raging Wolf Set; returning to Volcano Manor, Bernahl rewards Gelmir's Fury sorcery.
steps.warning: Becomes unavailable if you defeat Rykard before completing it or if Crumbling Farum Azula is already cleared.

steps.title: Speak to Bernahl after Rykard
steps.detail: After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, speak with Bernahl at Volcano Manor; he warns that the recusant path leads to a miserable death.

steps.title: Final invasion in Crumbling Farum Azula
steps.detail: After Rykard's defeat and emptying the manor, Recusant Bernahl invades on the path to the Old Lord's Talisman chest past the 'Beside the Great Bridge' grace; defeating him drops the Blasphemous Claw, Devourer's Scepter, the Beast Champion Set, and Bernahl's Bell Bearing.
steps.location: Crumbling Farum Azula, past Beside the Great Bridge
steps.warning: Until this invasion occurs you may still summon Bernahl for the Godskin Duo fight.

summary: Diallos Hoslow seeks vengeance for his lost servant Lanya, infiltrates the Volcano Manor assassins, and finds redemption defending the villagers of Jarburg.
reward: Diallos's Mask, Hoslow's Petal Whip, Numen's Rune

steps.title: Meet Diallos at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Speak with Diallos at the Roundtable Hold, where he mentions searching for his servant Lanya, whom the Recusants captured.

steps.title: Find Diallos at Academy Gate Town
steps.detail: Find Diallos atop a sunken roof north and slightly west of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace in Liurnia, and exhaust his dialogue about avenging Lanya.
steps.warning: If you complete the Volcano Manor legacy dungeon before speaking to Diallos here, he will not appear and you cannot complete the quest.

steps.title: Return to the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Rest at a Site of Grace, then return to the Roundtable Hold and exhaust all dialogue; he reveals he has found the Recusants' headquarters on Mt. Gelmir.

steps.title: Find Diallos at Volcano Manor
steps.detail: After joining the Manor, find Diallos in the drawing room; he has decided to infiltrate the organization and gains new dialogue for each assassination contract you complete.

steps.title: Trigger his departure from the Manor
steps.detail: After accepting the second Letter from Volcano Manor or defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, exhaust his dialogue (reloading the area) until he mentions his brother, then reload again so he leaves.
steps.warning: It is possible to skip the assassination missions and still have Diallos appear in Jarburg.

steps.title: Find Diallos at Jarburg
steps.detail: After progressing Jar-Bairn's questline, repeatedly talk to Jar-Bairn and rest at the Jarburg Site of Grace until he mentions poachers; Diallos then appears in one of the shacks tending a small jar.
steps.warning: Progress Jar-Bairn's questline first.

steps.title: Exhaust dialogue at Jarburg
steps.detail: Talk to Diallos and Jar-Bairn multiple times, exhausting all dialogue, then rest at the Site of Grace to advance the quest.

steps.title: The poacher attack
steps.detail: After defeating Radahn and speaking with Alexander in Radahn's arena, return to Jarburg; it comes under attack and Diallos fights to defend the jars, leaving him gravely wounded.
steps.warning: One night cycle may be required; try resting at the Jarburg grace and 'Pass Time until nightfall'.

steps.title: Diallos's final words
steps.detail: Exhaust dialogue with the wounded Diallos and tell him whether he successfully defended the jars; he dies shortly after either response.

steps.title: Collect his rewards
steps.detail: Reload the area after his death and collect his belongings where his body lay: Diallos's Mask, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and a Numen's Rune (12,500 runes).

summary: The treacherous merchant Patches ambushes you in Murkwater Cave and repeatedly betrays you across four regions before reforming as a friendly vendor.
reward: Grovel for Mercy gesture, Magma Whip Candlestick, Dancer's Castanets

steps.title: Trigger the Murkwater Cave ambush
steps.detail: In Murkwater Cave, Limgrave, open the chest at the cave's end past the Highwayman bandits to trigger the Patches boss fight.

steps.title: Accept his surrender
steps.detail: Reduce Patches to about 50% health and stop attacking when he surrenders; he yields 2x Golden Rune [1] and the Grovel for Mercy gesture and becomes a merchant.
steps.warning: Killing Patches during this fight loses him as a merchant; his Bell Bearing can then be given to the Twin Maiden Husks.

steps.title: Spring the chest trap
steps.detail: Open the chest in his Murkwater Cave shop; it teleports you away to the Mistwood Ruins, and on returning he gives the Calm Down gesture.
steps.warning: The chest is a trap that transports you away.

steps.title: Find Patches in Liurnia
steps.detail: Progress to Liurnia of the Lakes, where Patches relocates to Scenic Isle and begins selling Fan Daggers; he recommends using the Abductor Virgin at Raya Lucaria's waterwheel.
steps.location: Scenic Isle, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Take the Abductor Virgin
steps.detail: Let the Abductor Virgin at the bottom of the Raya Lucaria Academy waterwheel capture you; it transports you to Volcano Manor.
steps.warning: Patches misdirects you, claiming it leads to the Erdtree.

steps.title: The Mt. Gelmir cliff kick
steps.detail: Follow the rainbow stone trail Patches marks west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace; a cutscene plays in which he kicks you off the cliff and tells you to stay away from Volcano Manor.
steps.location: Mt. Gelmir, west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace
steps.warning: His shop closes during this phase.

steps.title: Reunite at Volcano Manor
steps.detail: Having joined Volcano Manor, speak to Patches in the entrance hall; his shop reopens and he becomes available for an assassination assignment.

steps.title: Patches' assassination contract
steps.detail: After completing one Tanith assassination request, speak to Patches to receive the Letter to Patches targeting Great Horned Tragoth; completing it earns the Magma Whip Candlestick.
steps.warning: Must complete the Tragoth assassination before Patches leaves Volcano Manor or the Magma Whip Candlestick is missed.

steps.title: Find Patches at the Shaded Castle
steps.detail: After defeating the God-Devouring Serpent (Rykard's arena), find Patches incapacitated at the Shaded Castle before the Elemer of the Briar boss room; he gives the Dancer's Castanets to deliver to Tanith.
steps.location: The Shaded Castle, before the Elemer of the Briar boss room
steps.warning: Do not attack him here or the quest ends prematurely.

steps.title: Final Murkwater Cave rematch
steps.detail: Return to Murkwater Cave for a final fight; Patches surrenders almost immediately, gives the Patches' Crouch gesture, and becomes friendly again (reload the area for his shop to reopen).

summary: A traumatized refugee at the Stormhill Shack who, with the player's encouragement, overcomes her grief to become the Roundtable Hold's spirit tuner.
reward: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes, Golden Seed, spirit tuning service (Spirit Ash upgrades), Crimson Hood

steps.title: Meet Roderika at Stormhill Shack
steps.detail: On the trail to Stormveil Castle, speak with Roderika and exhaust her dialogue. She gives you Spirit Jellyfish Ashes and the Sitting Sideways gesture.
steps.warning: If you skip her here, you can still get the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes later at the Roundtable Hold.

steps.title: Retrieve the Chrysalids' Memento
steps.detail: Inside Stormveil Castle, take the Chrysalids' Memento from a corpse pile near the Rampart Tower area for Roderika.

steps.title: Find Roderika at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: After resting at a Liurnia of the Lakes Site of Grace, Roderika relocates to the Roundtable Hold by the fireplace. Speak with her and give her the Chrysalids' Memento; she gives a Golden Seed.

steps.title: Arrange her apprenticeship with Hewg
steps.detail: Speak to Smithing Master Hewg about Roderika, relay his words to her, then speak to Hewg again so he agrees to teach her spirit tuning.
steps.warning: Requires having given her the Chrysalids' Memento first.

steps.title: Unlock spirit tuning
steps.detail: Leave and return; Roderika now sits beside Hewg's smithing area and offers Spirit Tuning, upgrading Spirit Ashes with Grave/Ghost Glovewort.

steps.title: Become a certified spirit tuner
steps.detail: Upgrade any Spirit Ash to +4, then return to Roderika; she rewards you with the Curtsy gesture.

steps.title: Collect the Crimson Hood
steps.detail: After completing her questline, return to the corpse pile in Stormveil Castle where you found the Chrysalids' Memento to claim her discarded Crimson Hood.

summary: A Tarnished warrior, ward of Gideon Ofnir, whom the player aids in claiming her place as ruler of Stormveil.
reward: Arsenal Charm, Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, summonable for the Godfrey, First Elden Lord fight

steps.title: Meet Nepheli in Stormveil Castle
steps.detail: Find Nepheli in a room before the Secluded Cell Site of Grace; exhaust her dialogue. You may summon her for the Godrick fight via her golden summon sign outside the boss fog.

steps.title: Speak with Gideon, then Nepheli at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: At the Roundtable Hold, speak with Gideon Ofnir, then find Nepheli in the room outside the library and exhaust her dialogue to receive the Arsenal Charm.
steps.warning: Speak to Gideon first or Nepheli will not appear.

steps.title: Find Nepheli at the Village of the Albinaurics
steps.detail: Find Nepheli beneath the stone bridge at the Village of the Albinaurics in Liurnia and exhaust her dialogue; defeat the Omenkiller across the area.
steps.warning: Do not give her Seluvis's Potion if you want to complete her questline.

steps.title: Give Nepheli The Stormhawk King
steps.detail: Obtain The Stormhawk King ashes from the Chapel of Anticipation and give them to Nepheli at the Roundtable Hold instead of Seluvis's Potion.
steps.warning: Give the ashes before defeating Maliketh, or she leaves permanently.

steps.title: Reunite at the Stormveil throne room
steps.detail: After defeating Morgott, the Omen King, return to Stormveil Castle's throne room; rest at the Secluded Cell then Godrick graces to find Nepheli, Kenneth, and Gostoc. Nepheli gives an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone and becomes ruler of Stormveil.
steps.warning: Requires defeating Morgott; if Gideon Ofnir is killed, Nepheli dies and the quest fails.

summary: A would-be lord of Limgrave who asks the player to reclaim Fort Haight and later seeks a worthy ruler for the land.
reward: Erdsteel Dagger

steps.title: Meet Kenneth Haight
steps.detail: Speak with Kenneth atop a ruin in northeastern Limgrave, between the Mistwood Outskirts and Third Church of Marika Sites of Grace; he asks you to clear Fort Haight.

steps.title: Clear Fort Haight
steps.detail: Travel to Fort Haight and defeat the Godrick Knight atop the battlements, who drops the Ash of War: Bloody Slash.

steps.title: Return to Kenneth for your reward
steps.detail: Return to Kenneth at the ruins; he takes up residence in the fort and rewards you with the Erdsteel Dagger.

steps.title: Reunite with Kenneth at Stormveil
steps.detail: After defeating Morgott, the Omen King, Kenneth relocates to the Stormveil Castle throne room as part of Nepheli's questline; rest at the Godrick grace and speak with him.
steps.warning: He promises to knight you but never actually does.

summary: The All-Knowing host of the Roundtable Hold who rewards the player with incantations for locating hidden demigods before becoming a mandatory late-game boss.
reward: Fevor's Cookbook [3], Black Flame's Protection, Law of Causality, Lord's Divine Fortification (and his boss drops)

steps.title: Meet Gideon at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Upon first arriving at the Roundtable Hold, speak to Gideon in his study; he directs you to obtain a Great Rune and the Two Fingers' guidance.

steps.title: Report the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum
steps.detail: After discovering the location of the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum, report it to Gideon to receive Fevor's Cookbook [3].

steps.title: Report Miquella's Haligtree
steps.detail: After locating Miquella's Haligtree, report it to Gideon to receive the Black Flame's Protection incantation.

steps.title: Report defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood
steps.detail: After defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood, tell Gideon to receive the Law of Causality incantation.

steps.title: Report defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella
steps.detail: After defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, tell Gideon to receive the Lord's Divine Fortification incantation.
steps.warning: Collect his incantation rewards before defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, after which Gideon leaves the Roundtable Hold.

steps.title: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing
steps.detail: After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold and fight Gideon as a boss; he drops the Scepter of the All-Knowing and the All-Knowing armor set.
steps.warning: Mandatory; triggers after major late-game story progression.

summary: A cleric who leaves the Roundtable Hold to follow the scholar Goldmask, only to lose his faith as Goldmask's heretical conclusions unravel the Golden Order.
reward: Prayer gesture, Immutable Shield incantation, Corhyn's Bell Bearing, Corhyn's Robe

steps.title: Meet Corhyn at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Speak with Brother Corhyn in the main room of the Roundtable Hold; he teaches incantations and gives the Prayer gesture.

steps.title: Find Corhyn on the Altus Plateau
steps.detail: After reaching the Altus Plateau and resting, Corhyn leaves to search for Goldmask; find him along the northern road from the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, where his shop expands.

steps.title: Locate Goldmask and tell Corhyn
steps.detail: Find Goldmask on the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge in northern Altus, then return to Corhyn and inform him; after resting he moves to join Goldmask.

steps.title: Find Corhyn and Goldmask together
steps.detail: Find the pair together on the bridge above the Road of Iniquity Side Path; Corhyn becomes Goldmask's scribe and his shop expands further.
steps.location: Bridge above Road of Iniquity Side Path

steps.title: Solve the riddle at Leyndell
steps.detail: Find Corhyn and Goldmask on a cliff east of the colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Cast Law of Regression on the statue west of the Erdtree Sanctuary grace to reveal that Radagon is Marika, then report to Goldmask. Corhyn then sells the Immutable Shield incantation.
steps.warning: Must be done before burning the Erdtree; if missed, Corhyn vanishes and leaves only his Bell Bearing at the colosseum.

steps.title: Find them at the Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.detail: Both Corhyn and Goldmask relocate to the bridge south of the Stargazers' Ruins, above the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace, where Corhyn voices his doubts.
steps.warning: Progress this stage before completing Crumbling Farum Azula, or Corhyn may not survive. Optionally giving the Tonic of Forgetfulness alters his ending.

steps.title: Witness Corhyn's end in the Ashen Capital
steps.detail: After defeating Maliketh and progressing the story, find Corhyn near the base of the giant spiral spear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, where he breaks down. After exhausting his dialogue, reload to loot his Flail, Corhyn's Bell Bearing, and Corhyn's Robe.
steps.warning: If you gave the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he instead remains at the Stargazers' Ruins bridge.

summary: A silent scholar who studies the Golden Order's flaws and, with the player's help, devises the Mending Rune that enables the Age of Order ending.
reward: Golden Order Totality gesture, Goldmask's Set, Mending Rune of Perfect Order (Age of Order / Goldmask's Fellowship ending)

steps.title: Find Goldmask on the Altus Plateau
steps.detail: Find Goldmask standing in contemplation on the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge in northern Altus Plateau; interacting with him advances the quest.

steps.title: Find Goldmask at Leyndell
steps.detail: After gaining access to Leyndell, Royal Capital, find Goldmask on a cliff by the colosseum.
steps.warning: Must reach Leyndell before burning the Erdtree.

steps.title: Reveal the statue's secret
steps.detail: Cast the Law of Regression incantation (requires 37 Intelligence) on the hidden statue west of the Erdtree Sanctuary grace to reveal that Radagon is Marika.
steps.warning: Missable; must be done before progressing too far. Requires 37 Intelligence (respec with a Larval Tear if needed).

steps.title: Report back to Goldmask
steps.detail: Speak to Goldmask at the Leyndell colosseum after revealing the statue's secret; he gives the Golden Order Totality gesture.

steps.title: Follow Goldmask to the Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.detail: Goldmask and Corhyn relocate to a high vantage point in the Mountaintops of the Giants (the bridge south of the Stargazers' Ruins).
steps.warning: Must reach this stage before burning the Erdtree, or the Age of Order ending is locked.

steps.title: Obtain the Mending Rune of Perfect Order
steps.detail: After defeating the Elden Beast, find Goldmask's corpse south-southwest of the Ashen Capital Site of Grace, across the log bridge and up the stairs, to receive the Mending Rune of Perfect Order, which enables the Age of Order ending.

steps.title: Collect Goldmask's Set
steps.detail: Return to Goldmask's corpse after taking the Mending Rune to claim Goldmask's Set (the Radiant Gold Mask is found separately on the Altus Plateau).

summary: Gideon Ofnir's silent attendant at the Roundtable Hold who invades the player as an NPC after a Haligtree Secret Medallion half is obtained.
reward: Royal Remains Set, Clinging Bone

steps.title: Encounter Ensha at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Find Ensha seated to the right of the entrance, outside Gideon Ofnir's room; interacting with him yields the "What Do You Want?" gesture.

steps.title: Obtain a Haligtree Secret Medallion half
steps.detail: Acquire either the right or left half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, which triggers Ensha's invasion.
steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Castle Sol
steps.warning: If neither medallion half is obtained before killing the Fire Giant and resting at the Forge of the Giants grace, Ensha vanishes permanently.

steps.title: Defeat Ensha's invasion
steps.detail: Return to the Roundtable Hold, where Ensha of the Royal Remains invades; defeat him. He wields the Clinging Bone and a Meteorite Staff.

steps.title: Collect Ensha's drops
steps.detail: Return to where Ensha originally sat outside Gideon's room to pick up the Royal Remains Set and the Clinging Bone.

summary: Fia, the Deathbed Companion, sends you to gather the marks of Death so she can unleash the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince and the Age of the Duskborn ending.
reward: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince; Radiant Baldachin's Blessing

steps.title: Receive Fia's embrace
steps.detail: Find Fia in her small bedroom at the Roundtable Hold and let her embrace you to receive Baldachin's Blessing, which boosts poise at the cost of 5% max HP while held.
steps.warning: Holding Baldachin's Blessing reduces max HP by 5% until it is consumed.

steps.title: Return after the Radahn Festival
steps.detail: After initiating the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle, return to Fia at the Roundtable Hold; she gives you the Weathered Dagger to deliver to D, Hunter of the Dead.
steps.warning: This step cannot be completed after reaching Crumbling Farum Azula.

steps.title: Get the Knifeprint Clue
steps.detail: Speak with Sorcerer Rogier about the Black Knives, then return to Fia, who gives you the Knifeprint Clue.
steps.warning: Rogier must still be alive; if he has died you cannot progress this way.

steps.title: Fia relocates
steps.detail: Reload the area after receiving the Knifeprint Clue; Fia briefly appears in a newly opened room near the blacksmith, then disappears from the Roundtable Hold.

steps.title: Defeat Fia's Champions in Deeproot Depths
steps.detail: Travel to Deeproot Depths and, from the Across the Roots Site of Grace, enter the arena to the north and defeat Fia's Champions; spirit ash summons are allowed.

steps.title: Bring Fia the Cursemark of Death
steps.detail: Speak with Fia in the arena, accept her hug, then bring her the Cursemark of Death obtained from Ranni's questline; give it to her where she sits.
steps.warning: Requires the Cursemark of Death from Ranni's questline.

steps.title: Enter the Deathbed Dream and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax
steps.detail: Exhaust her dialogue, reload so she falls asleep, then inspect sleeping Fia to enter her dream and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax.
steps.warning: This is the only opportunity to fight Lichdragon Fortissax; victory is required to progress.

steps.title: Claim the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince
steps.detail: After defeating Lichdragon Fortissax, pick up the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia's body; use it at the Roundtable Hold's Elden Ring for the Age of the Duskborn ending.

steps.title: Resolve the Twinned Armor with D's brother
steps.detail: Give the unaltered Twinned Set to D's brother (seated past the Valiant Gargoyles grace); after reloading, Fia's Set appears by her body and he leaves the Twinned Set and Inseparable Sword. Alternatively, kill him directly for both sets and the sword.
steps.warning: Giving him the armor causes him to desecrate Fia's corpse.

summary: D, a hunter of Those Who Live in Death, points you toward Gurranq and the slaying of Deathroot-bearing foes before his quest fatally collides with Fia's.
reward: Order's Blade and Litany of Proper Death incantations; Twinned Set; D's Bell Bearing; Inner Order gesture

steps.title: Meet D in Stormhill
steps.detail: Speak with D standing over a corpse in Stormhill, east of the Stormhill Shack; he warns of Those Who Live in Death around Summonwater Village.
steps.warning: This is the only time D can be fought; killing him here yields the full Twinned Set and D's Bell Bearing but ends his merchant role.

steps.title: Defeat the Tibia Mariner
steps.detail: Travel to Summonwater Village and defeat the Tibia Mariner; D can be summoned to help.

steps.title: Show D some Deathroot
steps.detail: Find D again at the southwestern entrance of Summonwater Village, then return to him with Deathroot and accept his offer to introduce you to Gurranq, which marks a Sending Gate on your map.

steps.title: Visit Gurranq at the Bestial Sanctum
steps.detail: Take the Sending Gate to the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid and meet Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

steps.title: D becomes a merchant at Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Return to D at the Roundtable Hold and exhaust dialogue to unlock the Golden Order incantations Litany of Proper Death and Order's Blade for purchase.

steps.title: Deliver the Weathered Dagger to D
steps.detail: Obtain the Weathered Dagger from Fia (after starting the Radahn Festival) and give it to D at the Roundtable Hold; a hidden room opens at the back of the Hold.
steps.warning: This step cannot be completed after reaching Crumbling Farum Azula.

steps.title: Loot the hidden room
steps.detail: Reload the area and enter the newly opened chamber at the back of the Roundtable Hold to take the Twinned Set and D's Bell Bearing.

steps.title: Meet D's twin brother in Nokron
steps.detail: Find D's twin brother on the balcony just before the Valiant Gargoyle arena in Nokron, Eternal City; interacting with him grants the Inner Order gesture.

steps.title: Give the Twinned Set to D's brother
steps.detail: Approach D's twin brother with the unaltered Twinned Set in your inventory; after reloading he becomes summonable as 'D, Beholder of Death' for the Valiant Gargoyle fight.

steps.title: D's death and the brother's revenge
steps.detail: When Fia's questline concludes in Deeproot Depths, D appears and kills her; reload to find his twin brother triumphant over her corpse, leaving behind the Twinned Set and Inseparable Sword.

summary: The imprisoned Dung Eater has you gather Seedbed Curses so he can curse all of the Lands Between, yielding the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse and the Blessing of Despair ending.
reward: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse; Omen Set; Sword of Milos

steps.title: Meet the Dung Eater at Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: After reaching the Altus Plateau, speak with the Dung Eater in the locked room past the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.
steps.warning: He will not engage unless you have a Seedbed Curse.

steps.title: Obtain the Sewer-Gaol Key
steps.detail: Return to the Dung Eater while carrying at least one Seedbed Curse; he gives you the Sewer-Gaol Key without consuming the curse.

steps.title: Release him from his cell
steps.detail: From the Underground Roadside grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, work northwest past the Giant Miranda Sprouts and use the Sewer-Gaol Key on his cell, then choose to release him.
steps.warning: Attacking him before releasing him can break the quest.

steps.title: Summon him for Mohg, the Omen (optional)
steps.detail: After release, the Dung Eater's cooperator summon sign appears outside the Mohg, the Omen boss fog in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
steps.warning: His summon sign disappears once you advance his quest past the Outer Moat invasion.

steps.title: Defeat the Dung Eater at the Outer Moat
steps.detail: Travel to the Outer Moat northeast of Leyndell, exhaust Blackguard Big Boggart's dialogue, walk toward the moat, and defeat the invading Dung Eater for the Sword of Milos.
steps.warning: Complete Blackguard Big Boggart's questline first or you may lose his Seedbed Curse drop.

steps.title: Speak with him back at the Roundtable Hold
steps.detail: Return to the Dung Eater at the Roundtable Hold; he asks you to bring Seedbed Curses to his body back in the cell.

steps.title: Feed him five Seedbed Curses (true ending)
steps.detail: Return to his body tied to the chair in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and give him Seedbed Curses one at a time until he has received five total.
steps.warning: Giving him Seluvis's Potion instead turns him into a puppet and locks out the Blessing of Despair ending.

steps.title: Collect the Omen Set
steps.detail: After receiving the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse, reload the area to find the Omen Set where he sat.

summary: The blind maiden Hyetta seeks the Frenzied Flame, asking you for Shabriri Grapes as you guide her toward Leyndell to become your Finger Maiden of the Three Fingers.
reward: Frenzied Flame Seal; five Frenzyflame Stones

steps.title: Receive Irina's letter
steps.detail: Speak with Irina in the Weeping Peninsula to receive her letter, which is required for Hyetta to appear.
steps.warning: Killing Irina before speaking to her prevents Hyetta from spawning entirely.

steps.title: Offer a Shabriri Grape at the Lake-Facing Cliffs
steps.detail: Meet Hyetta at the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace in Liurnia of the Lakes and give her a Shabriri Grape to receive the As You Wish gesture.
steps.location: Lake-Facing Cliffs, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: If she does not appear, rest at the grace rather than only teleporting in.

steps.title: Feed her at the Purified Ruins
steps.detail: Find Hyetta on the western side of the Purified Ruins in Liurnia and give her another Shabriri Grape.
steps.location: Purified Ruins, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Tell her the truth at Gate Town Bridge
steps.detail: Give Hyetta a Shabriri Grape north of the Gate Town Bridge grace; when she asks what the grapes are, you must tell her they are human eyes.
steps.location: Gate Town Bridge, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: You must reload and exhaust all of her new dialogue before she will relocate.

steps.title: Bring the Fingerprint Grape to Bellum Church
steps.detail: Meet Hyetta at Bellum Church in northeastern Liurnia and give her a Fingerprint Grape, dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke near the Church of Inhibition.
steps.location: Bellum Church, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Burn her into your Finger Maiden
steps.detail: After accepting the Three Fingers' mark at the Frenzied Flame Proscription beneath Leyndell, return to Hyetta and rest your hand upon her; she burns and becomes your Finger Maiden, leaving the Frenzied Flame Seal and five Frenzyflame Stones.
steps.warning: Accepting the Three Fingers locks you into the Frenzied Flame ending unless reversed with Miquella's Needle at Dragonlord Placidusax's arena in Crumbling Farum Azula.

summary: The Bloody Finger hunter Yura aids you against invading Bloody Fingers across the Lands Between until his hunt for Eleonora ends in his death and his body is later claimed by Shabriri.
reward: Nagakiba; Eleonora's Poleblade; Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists; Purifying Crystal Tear

steps.title: Meet Yura near the Seaside Ruins
steps.detail: Speak with Yura under the overpass northeast of the Seaside Ruins grace in Limgrave; he warns about Flying Dragon Agheel in the lake.
steps.warning: You must speak to him at least once to progress.

steps.title: Defeat Flying Dragon Agheel (optional)
steps.detail: Kill Flying Dragon Agheel at Agheel Lake, optionally summoning Yura, after which he congratulates you and mentions Dragon Communion.
steps.warning: Missable congratulatory dialogue, but skipping it does not block the quest.

steps.title: Survive the Nerijus invasion at Murkwater Cave
steps.detail: Approaching Murkwater Cave triggers an invasion by Bloody Finger Nerijus; defeat him, with Yura available as a white summon.

steps.title: Talk to Yura after the Nerijus fight
steps.detail: Speak with Yura under the tunnel-like ruin north of Murkwater Cave, where he explains his mission of hunting Bloody Fingers.
steps.warning: You must speak to him here or he will not move on to Raya Lucaria.

steps.title: Aid Yura against the Ravenmount Assassin
steps.detail: Use Yura's red summon sign north of the Main Academy Gate grace at Raya Lucaria and defeat the Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin; afterward speak to Yura for Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.
steps.location: Main Academy Gate, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Meet Yura at the Second Church of Marika
steps.detail: Speak with the wounded Yura at the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau, where he gives you the Nagakiba just before Eleonora invades.
steps.location: Second Church of Marika, Altus Plateau

steps.title: Defeat Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger
steps.detail: Defeat the invading Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika; Yura dies of his wounds, leaving his body behind.
steps.location: Second Church of Marika, Altus Plateau
steps.warning: Quest becomes inaccessible after passing through the Rold Lift.

summary: Inhabiting the dead Yura's body, Shabriri urges you to embrace the Three Fingers and become the Lord of the Frenzied Flame.
reward: Lord of the Frenzied Flame ending; Ronin's Set

steps.title: Meet Shabriri in Yura's body
steps.detail: Speak with Shabriri, who has taken over Yura's corpse, at the Zamor Ruins grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants; he describes the Frenzied Flame path.
steps.location: Zamor Ruins, Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.warning: If you meet the Three Fingers before reaching Shabriri he never appears, leaving only the Ronin's Set on the ground.

steps.title: Travel to the Three Fingers
steps.detail: Follow Shabriri's directions to the Cathedral of the Forsaken beneath the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, removing your armor to open the sealed door.
steps.location: Cathedral of the Forsaken, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

steps.title: Embrace the Three Fingers
steps.detail: Descend to the Three Fingers and embrace the Frenzied Flame to become its vessel and unlock the Lord of the Frenzied Flame ending.
steps.location: Cathedral of the Forsaken, Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
steps.warning: This choice locks out all other endings unless reversed with Miquella's Needle at Dragonlord Placidusax's arena in Crumbling Farum Azula.

steps.title: Claim the Ronin's Set
steps.detail: After embracing the Three Fingers, Shabriri vanishes and leaves the Ronin's Set where he stood; he can also be killed at Zamor Ruins for the same set.
steps.location: Zamor Ruins, Mountaintops of the Giants

summary: Free a demi-human seamster trapped in a tree, recover his tailoring tools, and guide him through self-acceptance for free garment alterations.
reward: Free garment alterations, "My Lord" gesture

steps.title: Free Boc from the tree
steps.detail: Attack the talking tree northwest of Murkwater Bridge (east of the telescope south of Agheel Lake North) to break the spell and free Boc, who asks you to wait while he retrieves his belongings.

steps.title: Recover his tools at Coastal Cave
steps.detail: Enter Coastal Cave and defeat the boss to recover Boc's tools, then return to him at the cave entrance and give him the items.

steps.title: Meet Boc at the Lake-Facing Cliffs
steps.detail: Rest at the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace north of Stormveil Castle to summon Boc; free garment alterations become available here.
steps.location: Lake-Facing Cliffs, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Find Boc at East Raya Lucaria Gate
steps.detail: After accessing Raya Lucaria Academy, rest at the East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace to find Boc; Melina also appears here and remarks on him.
steps.location: East Raya Lucaria Gate, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Find Boc at Altus Highway Junction
steps.detail: Rest at the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau to find Boc relocated there.

steps.title: Find Boc at East Capital Rampart
steps.detail: Rest at the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell to find Boc; to progress further you must own the Gold Sewing Needle (from Church of Vows) and alterable legendary demigod armor from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
steps.location: East Capital Rampart, Leyndell Royal Capital
steps.warning: Only demigod armor counts as legendary and unlocks the Gold Sewing Needle upgrade option; other alterable armor won't trigger it. After burning the Erdtree and defeating Maliketh, Boc's map marker disappears but he remains here.

steps.title: Reassure Boc with the Prattling Pate (recommended ending)
steps.detail: Use the "You're beautiful" Prattling Pate (from Hermit Village, Mt. Gelmir) in front of Boc, then answer "yes" when he asks if you think he's beautiful, completing the quest peacefully.
steps.location: East Capital Rampart, Leyndell Royal Capital
steps.warning: Using the Prattling Pate removes the option to give a Larval Tear. Giving a Larval Tear instead leads to his death, and doing nothing causes him to relocate to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library and die.

summary: Guide a blind Albinauric markswoman toward her sister at the Haligtree by carrying her spirit and uniting the two halves of the Haligtree Secret Medallion.
reward: Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ashes), Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.title: Obtain the Right Medallion from Albus
steps.detail: Speak with Albus, hidden as a pot in the Village of the Albinaurics, to receive the right half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion.
steps.location: Village of the Albinaurics, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Show Latenna the Right Medallion
steps.detail: Clear the Lakeside Crystal Cave dungeon, then approach Latenna at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack and show her the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) to gain her trust and receive her as a spirit summon.
steps.location: Slumbering Wolf's Shack, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: Obtaining the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) before showing her the Right Medallion will cause her to die, failing the quest.

steps.title: Travel to the Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.detail: Carry Latenna's spirit to the area northeast of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins near the frozen river; summoning her there triggers dialogue hinting at the Left Medallion's location in Castle Sol.
steps.location: Northeast of Ancient Snow Valley Ruins, Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.warning: Her dialogue may not trigger if Ranni's questline is already complete.

steps.title: Reach the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield
steps.detail: Progress into the Consecrated Snowfield to the Apostate Derelict, interact with the giant Albinauric woman (Phillia), and summon Latenna there to complete the quest.

summary: Join Mohg's blood cult by performing invasions and a blood-soaking ritual to be anointed a Knight of Blood and gain early access to Mohgwyn Palace.
reward: Pureblood Knight's Medal, Bloody Finger

steps.title: Meet Varré at the First Step
steps.detail: Speak with White Mask Varré at the First Step Site of Grace at the very start of the game and exhaust his dialogue.

steps.title: Obtain a Great Rune and meet the Two Fingers
steps.detail: Defeat a shardbearer demigod to obtain a Great Rune, meet Enia at Roundtable Hold, then request an audience with the Two Fingers in the inner chamber to advance Varré's quest.
steps.warning: Touching the Two Fingers is what triggers Varré's relocation to Rose Church.

steps.title: Find Varré at Rose Church
steps.detail: Travel to Rose Church on the southwest island of Liurnia, speak with Varré, and receive Festering Bloody Fingers to begin invading.
steps.location: Rose Church, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Complete invasions (or defeat Magnus the Beast Claw)
steps.detail: Invade three players using the Festering Bloody Finger, or instead defeat the field boss at Writheblood Ruins, then report back to Varré.
steps.location: Rose Church, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: Defeating the boss is an optional substitute; three successful invasions suffice.

steps.title: Soak the Lord of Blood's Favor in maiden's blood
steps.detail: Receive the white oath-cloth from Varré and soak it in a dead maiden's blood at a corpse such as the Church of Inhibition, the Chapel of Anticipation (via the Four Belfries portal), or Irina's/Hyetta's body.
steps.location: Rose Church, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: Using Hyetta's corpse kills her and prevents completing her questline.

steps.title: Be anointed by Varré
steps.detail: Return the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor to Varré at Rose Church; he pierces your finger to anoint you, turning your eyes blood-red and giving a reusable invasion finger.
steps.location: Rose Church, Liurnia of the Lakes

steps.title: Receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal
steps.detail: Speak with Varré again after the ceremony to receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal, which teleports you to Mohgwyn Palace without crossing the Consecrated Snowfield.
steps.location: Rose Church, Liurnia of the Lakes

summary: A mistreated gatekeeper at Stormveil Castle who guides, robs, and traps you while quietly resenting Godrick's tyranny.
reward: Grace Mimic, Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, Gostoc's Bell Bearing

steps.title: Meet Gostoc at the castle gate
steps.detail: Speak with Gostoc at the Stormveil Castle entrance; he offers either the perilous main gate or the safer side path into the castle.
steps.warning: Opening the main gate prevents some of his later stalking appearances.

steps.title: Encounter Gostoc inside the castle
steps.detail: Progress through Stormveil and find Gostoc lurking at one of his spots (Ruined Watchtower behind Stormveil Cliffside grace, the rampart tower near the lift, or the chapel roof above Rogier); the first encounter yields the Grace Mimic.
steps.warning: His stalking spots are mutually exclusive; the Grace Mimic is obtained only at the first encounter.

steps.title: Survive the Rusty Key trap room
steps.detail: Enter the dark room holding the Rusty Key; Gostoc shuts the door behind you, forcing a fight before you can claim the key.
steps.warning: Gostoc's laughter signals the trap; killing him beforehand prevents the door from locking.

steps.title: Open Gostoc's shop
steps.detail: Obtain the Rusty Key (or defeat Godrick) and return to Gostoc at the main gate to open his merchant shop, after which he stops stealing your runes on death.
steps.warning: Until the shop opens, Gostoc steals 30% of your dropped runes whenever you die within the castle.

steps.title: Defeat Godrick the Grafted
steps.detail: Defeat Godrick in his throne room; Gostoc appears afterward to stomp on and berate Godrick's remains.

steps.title: Promote Gostoc as Nepheli's attendant
steps.detail: Complete Nepheli Loux's and Kenneth Haight's quests and defeat Morgott so Nepheli takes Godrick's throne; Gostoc becomes her attendant and sells the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
steps.warning: The Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone is only available if Gostoc is kept alive through this stage; killing him drops Gostoc's Bell Bearing instead.

summary: A living jar warrior who repeatedly gets stuck on his journey to become a champion, ending in a final duel that yields his power.
reward: Shard of Alexander, Alexander's Innards

steps.title: Free Alexander in Stormhill
steps.detail: Find Alexander stuck headfirst in the ground in northern Stormhill (north of Agheel Lake North, west of the river), choose to help him, and strike his back repeatedly to free him.

steps.title: Talk to Alexander at Gael Tunnel
steps.detail: Speak with Alexander beyond the door inside Gael Tunnel on the Caelid border and exhaust his dialogue about the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle.
steps.warning: You may skip this location if the Radahn Festival has already been triggered via Blaidd's questline.

steps.title: Meet Alexander at the Radahn Festival
steps.detail: Speak with Alexander among the festival participants at Redmane Castle; you can summon him as a cooperator for the Starscourge Radahn fight.

steps.title: Speak with Alexander at the Wailing Dunes
steps.detail: After defeating Radahn, find Alexander scavenging the fallen soldiers south of the Starscourge Radahn Site of Grace and exhaust his dialogue.
steps.warning: Talk to him before leaving the area.

steps.title: Free Alexander again in Liurnia
steps.detail: Find Alexander stuck in a hole south of the Carian Study Hall (follow the path from the Artist's Shack), pour an Oil Pot or Roped Oil Pot on him, then strike him to free him.
steps.location: South of Carian Study Hall, Liurnia of the Lakes
steps.warning: This step can be skipped by progressing directly to Mt. Gelmir after the Radahn Festival.

steps.title: Speak with Alexander in the Mt. Gelmir lava lake
steps.detail: Reach Alexander on the rock outcropping in the lava lake south of Fort Laiedd near the Seethewater Terminus, and exhaust his dialogue referencing the Forge of Giants.
steps.warning: Exhaust all dialogue before progressing.

steps.title: Summon Alexander against the Fire Giant
steps.detail: Summon Alexander's cooperator sign inside the Fire Giant arena, where he is immune to fire damage and deals heavy stance damage.
steps.location: Fire Giant arena, Mountaintops of the Giants
steps.warning: Alexander won't appear at Farum Azula until the Fire Giant is defeated and the story has progressed.

steps.title: Duel Alexander at Crumbling Farum Azula
steps.detail: Find Alexander on the flat arena past the Dragon Temple Lift, accept his duel, and defeat him to claim his power.
steps.warning: You can attack during his post-battle dialogue to skip it and still receive the rewards.

summary: A blind maiden asks you to carry a letter to her father Edgar at Castle Morne, beginning a tragic quest that ends with confronting the grief-maddened Edgar the Revenger.
reward: Banished Knight's Halberd, Shabriri Grape

steps.title: Meet Irina at the Bridge of Sacrifice
steps.detail: Speak with Irina sitting by the road at the Bridge of Sacrifice in the Weeping Peninsula to receive a letter for her father at Castle Morne.

steps.title: Deliver the letter to Edgar
steps.detail: Travel to Castle Morne, find the commander Edgar inside, and give him Irina's Letter; he refuses to leave while protecting the castle from the rebellion.

steps.title: Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten
steps.detail: Fight through Castle Morne and defeat the Leonine Misbegotten boss on the cliff terrace to end the assault threatening Edgar.

steps.title: Speak with Edgar after the battle
steps.detail: Return to Edgar at Castle Morne; freed from his duty, he thanks you and resolves to return to Irina.
steps.warning: An Iron Cleaver can be found embedded in the ground near Irina's spot after this point.

steps.title: Find Irina dead at the Bridge of Sacrifice
steps.detail: Return to the Bridge of Sacrifice to find Irina dead and Edgar grieving over her body, after which he vows revenge.
steps.warning: Irina dies if you defeat the Leonine Misbegotten before delivering her letter, or take too long; killing Irina yourself prevents Hyetta from ever appearing.

steps.title: Defeat Edgar the Revenger
steps.detail: Travel to the Revenger's Shack in western Liurnia, where Edgar invades as the hostile "Edgar the Revenger"; defeat him to end the questline.
steps.location: Revenger's Shack, Liurnia of the Lakes

summary: A young living jar in Jarburg searches for a worthy Potentate while dreaming of becoming a warrior like his Uncle Alexander, his fate entwined with Diallos.
reward: Companion Jar Talisman

steps.title: Meet Jar Bairn in Jarburg
steps.detail: Speak with Jar Bairn on the stairs at the west end of Jarburg and offer to be his Potentate; he rejects you for your rough hands.
steps.warning: Never destroy the living jars in Jarburg or the questline becomes inaccessible.

steps.title: Exhaust Jar Bairn's early dialogue
steps.detail: Reload the area and talk to Jar Bairn repeatedly until you exhaust his dialogue about the village's rare flowers, his Uncle Alexander, and a warning about poachers.
steps.warning: The poacher-warning dialogue is mandatory before the quest can progress.

steps.title: Bring Diallos to Jarburg
steps.detail: Progress Diallos's Volcano Manor questline (or defeat Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, then speak to him) so Diallos relocates to Jarburg, then exhaust both Diallos's and Jar Bairn's dialogue.

steps.title: Defeat Radahn and exhaust Alexander's dialogue
steps.detail: Defeat Starscourge Radahn and exhaust Alexander's dialogue at the Wailing Dunes, then return to the Starscourge Radahn grace and fast-travel back to Jarburg to advance Jar Bairn's quest.

steps.title: Witness the poacher attack on Jarburg
steps.detail: Return to find Jarburg raided, several jars destroyed, and Diallos mortally wounded in the village center; speak to the dying Diallos and then to Jar Bairn nearby.
steps.warning: The attack may require a night cycle; rest at the grace to pass time until nightfall if it doesn't trigger. Diallos's Mask and Hoslow's Petal Whip appear in the village center.

steps.title: Give Jar Bairn Alexander's Innards
steps.detail: After completing Iron Fist Alexander's questline, reload and talk to Jar Bairn until he announces his warrior's journey, then give him Alexander's Innards.
steps.warning: Requires Alexander's Innards from completing Iron Fist Alexander's quest; killing Jar Bairn before giving it ends the quest permanently.

steps.title: Collect the Companion Jar Talisman
steps.detail: Reload the area and return to Jar Bairn's original spot to find he has departed, leaving the Companion Jar Talisman behind.

summary: A devoted follower of Miquella who rallies, then turns on, the band of Tarnished pursuing him, culminating in a final showdown at Enir-Ilim.
reward: Leda's Set, Leda's Sword, Lacerating Crossed-Tree / Retaliatory Crossed-Tree talismans

steps.title: Meet Leda at Miquella's cocoon
