steps.detail: After entering the Land of Shadow via the withered arm at the Cocoon of the Empyrean Grace in Mohgwyn Palace, find Leda beside the cocoon and exhaust her dialogue.
steps.location: Cocoon of the Empyrean Grace, Mohgwyn Palace
steps.warning: Requires defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood and reaching the cocoon in the base game.

steps.title: Read the cross messages
steps.detail: Find the Tower of Shadow Message near Belurat, Tower Settlement and the Castle Cross Message at Miquella's Cross in Castle Ensis to learn the band is gathering at Highroad Cross.

steps.title: Gather at Highroad Cross
steps.detail: Travel to the Highroad Cross Site of Grace in Scadu Altus and exhaust Leda's dialogue alongside the other assembled Tarnished (Ansbach, Hornsent, Freyja, Dane).
steps.warning: Rest at the grace repeatedly to cycle all members' dialogue.

steps.title: Break Miquella's charm
steps.detail: Trigger the great-rune/charm-breaking event by approaching Shadow Keep or crossing the bridge east of Bonny Village, then return to Highroad Cross and exhaust everyone's new dialogue.
steps.location: Shadow Keep entrance / Bonny Village bridge
steps.warning: Speak to all band members at Highroad Cross before this event; some dialogue is missed once the charm breaks.

steps.title: Hornsent confrontation in Shadow Keep
steps.detail: On the burning-boat battlements before the Storehouse elevator, Leda turns on Hornsent; answer Leda's red summon to kill Hornsent for her, or Hornsent's gold summon to defend him.
steps.warning: Entering Messmer's arena from the Dark Chamber Entrance before resolving this locks the choice out.

steps.title: Ansbach confrontation in Shadow Keep
steps.detail: In the Storehouse, First Floor, Leda turns on Ansbach; answer Leda's red summon to kill Ansbach (loot Ansbach's Set and Ansbach's Longbow) or his gold summon to defend him.
steps.warning: Ansbach must have received the Secret Rite Scroll for these summon signs to appear.

steps.title: Confront Leda at Enir-Ilim
steps.detail: At the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom in Enir-Ilim, fight Leda and the surviving band in the Leda and Allies battle, then loot her gear from her corpse.
steps.warning: Allies you sided against earlier fight alongside Leda here; allies you saved can be summoned to help.

summary: A Pureblood Knight of the Mohgwyn Dynasty who investigates Miquella's true intentions and, if befriended, fights at your side against the Promised Consort.
reward: Ansbach's Set, Obsidian Lamina, Furious Blade of Ansbach

steps.title: Meet Ansbach at Belurat
steps.detail: Speak with Sir Ansbach at his camp just outside Belurat, Tower Settlement, at the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace, and exhaust his dialogue about Miquella's Crosses.

steps.title: Find Miquella's Crosses
steps.detail: Interact with Miquella's Crosses (Belurat, then a second such as the Scaduview or Cerulean Coast cross) and report back to Ansbach for additional dialogue.
steps.warning: This bonus dialogue is lost once Miquella breaks Ansbach's great rune.

steps.title: Reunite after the rune breaks
steps.detail: After the great-rune-breaking event, return to Ansbach at Main Gate Cross and exhaust his new dialogue, then meet him again inside Shadow Keep.

steps.title: Hear Freyja's decision first
steps.detail: In the Storehouse, speak with Redmane Freyja (Seventh Floor) about her decision, then tell Ansbach (First Floor) about it before doing anything else.
steps.warning: Must be done before giving Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll, or Freyja's questline locks out.

steps.title: Find and give the Secret Rite Scroll
steps.detail: Retrieve the Secret Rite Scroll from a desk behind the tall bookshelves in the Storehouse and hand it to Ansbach on the First Floor.
steps.warning: If never given the scroll, Ansbach stays put, never yields the Letter for Freyja, and his questline stalls.

steps.title: Deliver the Letter for Freyja
steps.detail: Rest at a grace and return to Ansbach to receive the Letter for Freyja, give it to Freyja on the Seventh Floor, then report back to Ansbach.

steps.title: Side with Ansbach against Leda
steps.detail: When Leda turns on the band in the Storehouse, answer Ansbach's gold summon (not Leda's red) so he survives and remains summonable; doing nothing also keeps him alive.
steps.warning: Killing Hornsent before completing the Shadow Keep steps can block Ansbach's summon; answering Leda's red summon kills Ansbach.

steps.title: Summon Ansbach in the NPC battle
steps.detail: At the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom in Enir-Ilim, use Ansbach's gold summon sign for the Leda and Allies battle, then exhaust his dialogue at the top of the elevator.
steps.warning: If not summoned here, he cannot be summoned for the final boss.

steps.title: Summon Ansbach against the Promised Consort
steps.detail: At the final arena in Enir-Ilim, summon Ansbach for the Promised Consort Radahn fight; after the battle his gear drops near the arena entrance.
steps.warning: His items drop near the entrance regardless of whether he is summoned.

summary: A silent attendant devoted to St. Trina who seeks her across the Land of Shadow and, if his quest is completed, aids you against the Promised Consort.
reward: St. Trina's Smile, Thiollier's Hidden Needle, Thiollier's Set

steps.title: Meet Thiollier in Gravesite Plain
steps.detail: Speak with Thiollier next to the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain and exhaust his dialogue.

steps.title: Get Thiollier's Concoction from Moore
steps.detail: After advancing the story, obtain the ingredients from Moore to receive Thiollier's Concoction and learn of St. Trina.
steps.warning: Must be obtained before Thiollier leaves Gravesite Plain for the Garden of Deep Purple, or it becomes unavailable.

steps.title: Find St. Trina and tell Thiollier
steps.detail: Discover St. Trina deep in the Stone Coffin Fissure's Garden of Deep Purple, then return to Thiollier at Pillar Path Cross and tell him her whereabouts.
steps.location: Garden of Deep Purple, Stone Coffin Fissure
steps.warning: Reaching St. Trina requires defeating Putrescent Knight in the Stone Coffin Fissure.

steps.title: Imbibe St. Trina's nectar
steps.detail: Meet Thiollier at the Garden of Deep Purple, then repeatedly choose to imbibe St. Trina's nectar until you hear her voice on the death screen.
steps.warning: Takes roughly four imbibes; keep going until her voice is heard.

steps.title: Pass on St. Trina's words
steps.detail: Speak to Thiollier and select to pass on St. Trina's words twice; he grows enraged, then rest at a grace (or imbibe again) to trigger his invasion.

steps.title: Defeat Thiollier's invasion
steps.detail: Survive and defeat Thiollier when he invades, then talk to him in St. Trina's room and exhaust his dialogue.
steps.warning: Must be done before fighting the NPC allies in Enir-Ilim, or he disappears.

steps.title: Summon Thiollier at Enir-Ilim
steps.detail: After imbibing the nectar a couple more times to unlock his signs, summon Thiollier for the Leda and Allies battle and then for Promised Consort Radahn; collect his gear near the final arena entrance.
steps.warning: If not summoned for the NPC allies battle, he cannot be summoned for the final boss; his gear drops regardless.

summary: A Redmane warrior and former Radahn follower now sworn to Miquella, whose questline runs through the Ansbach letter exchange before she joins the band against you at Enir-Ilim.
reward: Golden Lion Shield, Freyja's Greatsword, Freyja's Set

steps.title: Meet Freyja in Gravesite Plain
steps.detail: Speak with Redmane Freyja at the Three-Path Cross in Gravesite Plain and exhaust her dialogue.

steps.title: Summon Freyja against the Divine Beast
steps.detail: Use her summon sign for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion at Belurat, Tower Settlement, then return to Three-Path Cross to hear new dialogue.

steps.title: Follow Freyja to Shadow Keep
steps.detail: After the great rune breaks, return to Three-Path Cross and exhaust her dialogue so she relocates, then summon her against the Golden Hippopotamus at the Shadow Keep Main Gate.
steps.location: Shadow Keep Main Gate, Scadu Altus

steps.title: Hear Freyja's decision in the Storehouse
steps.detail: Find Freyja at the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace struggling to read the scriptures and exhaust her dialogue about needing Ansbach's help.
steps.warning: Do not over-talk to her; you must then speak to Ansbach before giving him the Secret Rite Scroll.

steps.title: Relay between Ansbach and the scroll
steps.detail: Tell Ansbach (First Floor) about Freyja and exhaust his dialogue, then pick up the Secret Rite Scroll from the Storehouse and give it to him.
steps.warning: Giving Ansbach the scroll before telling him about Freyja makes him leave when you rest, locking out her quest.

steps.title: Deliver the Letter for Freyja
steps.detail: Rest at a grace, take the Letter for Freyja from Ansbach, give it to Freyja on the Seventh Floor and exhaust her dialogue, then report back to Ansbach.
steps.warning: Withholding the letter removes her from the Enir-Ilim battle and she vanishes from the Storehouse.

steps.title: Face Freyja at Enir-Ilim
steps.detail: If she received the letter, Freyja fights you in the Leda and Allies battle at the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom; loot her gear from her corpse afterward.

summary: A vengeance-driven drake warrior who guides you up Jagged Peak so he can finally confront his nemesis, the dragon Bayle the Dread.
reward: Igon's Greatbow, Igon's Set, Igon's Bell Bearing

steps.title: Find Igon on the path to Jagged Peak
steps.detail: Head south past the Pillar Path Waypoint and speak with the wounded Igon, exhausting his dialogue until he repeats his line about the exquisite pain.

steps.title: Descend through the Dragon's Pit
steps.detail: Travel the marble dragon-statue road into the cave, activate the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace, follow the lower tunnel to the ritual altar, and leap into the darkness.
steps.warning: Take the lower path, not the upper dragon arena; an NPC invasion is possible on the approach.

steps.title: Defeat the Ancient Dragon-Man
steps.detail: Beat the Ancient Dragon-Man behind the golden fog door to claim his weapon and open the way onward.

steps.title: Commune at the Grand Altar
steps.detail: Past a sleeping Jagged Peak Drake, reach the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion, exhaust the priestess's dialogue, and devour draconic essence.
steps.warning: Exhaust all of the Dragon Communion Priestess's dialogue here before finishing Igon's questline.

steps.title: Clear the Foot of the Jagged Peak
steps.detail: Use the Spiritspring to reach the Foot of the Jagged Peak Site of Grace, cross the bridge and defeat the two Jagged Peak Drakes, then find Igon in the red-smoke area to the southeast.

steps.title: Optionally beat Ancient Dragon Senessax
steps.detail: Climb the mountain via the Spiritsprings behind Igon and, if desired, defeat Ancient Dragon Senessax in the side cave before reaching the summit arena.
steps.warning: Dodge the rolling boulders inside the cave.

steps.title: Summon Igon against Bayle
steps.detail: At the Bayle the Dread arena, trigger the boss and use Igon's summon sign on the left side so he fights at your side, then defeat Bayle the Dread.
steps.location: Bayle the Dread arena, Jagged Peak
steps.warning: Igon's summon sign only appears after the boss is triggered; defeating Bayle leads to Igon's death.

steps.title: Collect Igon's gear
steps.detail: Return to the Foot of the Jagged Peak Site of Grace where the two drakes were fought to pick up Igon's dropped equipment.
steps.warning: His gear appears here whether or not he was summoned for Bayle.

summary: A vengeful survivor of the Hornsent race who hunts down Messmer and Marika's kin across the Land of Shadow, his fate decided by who you side with during Leda's betrayal.
reward: Falx, Hornsent Set, Soiled Loincloth (plus Ash of War: Swift Slash or Lacerating Crossed-Tree depending on choices)

steps.title: Meet Hornsent at Three-Path Cross
steps.detail: Speak with Hornsent, who stands alongside Redmane Freyja, and exhaust his dialogue to receive a diagram of Miquella's Crosses.

steps.title: Give Scorpion Stew to Hornsent Grandam
steps.detail: After defeating Divine Beast Dancing Lion, equip the Divine Beast Head and give Scorpion Stew to Hornsent Grandam in Belurat.
steps.warning: Only one Scorpion Stew can be given; can still be done after Hornsent relocates to Scadu Altus.

steps.title: Reunite at Highroad Cross
steps.detail: Upon first entering Scadu Altus, find Hornsent at the Highroad Cross grace and speak with him to receive an updated cross diagram.

steps.title: Break Miquella's Great Rune
steps.detail: Progress through Bonny Village and eastern Scadu Altus to break Miquella's great rune; you will see the message that a great rune and a powerful charm have been broken.

steps.title: Report back to Hornsent
steps.detail: Return to Hornsent at Highroad Cross after breaking the rune to advance his quest and trigger his move toward Shadow Keep.

steps.title: Summon Hornsent for the Golden Hippopotamus
steps.detail: Use Hornsent's summon sign at the Shadow Keep Main Gate grace to help defeat the Golden Hippopotamus.

steps.title: Choose a side in Leda's betrayal
steps.detail: On the Shadow Keep battlements near the Storehouse First Floor elevator, two summon signs appear when Leda turns on Hornsent; help Leda (red), help Hornsent (gold), or help neither.
steps.warning: Helping Hornsent grants Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune but locks the Lacerating Crossed-Tree; helping Leda grants the Falx, Hornsent Set and Lacerating Crossed-Tree but ends his quest and locks Swift Slash.

steps.title: Summon Hornsent against Messmer the Impaler
steps.detail: Use Hornsent's summon sign for the Messmer the Impaler fight so he can swear vengeance on Marika's family, which unlocks his later invasion and eases the Enir-Ilim battle.
steps.location: Shadow Keep, near Dark Chamber grace
steps.warning: Must be done before entering Messmer's room from the Dark Chamber Site of Grace, or the summon signs vanish.

steps.title: Defeat Hornsent's invasion in Rauh
steps.detail: If you summoned and exhausted his dialogue for Messmer, Hornsent invades atop the staircase near the Church of the Bud Main Entrance; defeat him to claim his gear.
steps.warning: Only occurs if Hornsent was summoned for the Messmer fight.

steps.title: Final battle at Enir-Ilim
steps.detail: In the climactic multi-NPC battle against Needle Knight Leda and Allies, Hornsent fights (as ally or foe by your path); loot his corpse for the remaining gear.

summary: A melancholic merchant tending the Forager Brood outside Belurat who shares cookbooks and a delivery for Thiollier, but may spiral into despair after Miquella's charm breaks.
reward: Forager Brood Cookbooks (1)-(7), Black Syrup, Moore's Bell Bearing, Verdigris Greatshield, Verdigris Set

steps.title: Meet Moore outside Belurat
steps.detail: Speak with Moore at his camp by the Main Gate Cross grace outside Belurat and buy any item to open his shop and unlock extra Ansbach dialogue.

steps.title: Meet Thiollier first
steps.detail: Visit Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross grace to unlock expanded Moore dialogue before either NPC relocates.
steps.warning: Do this before Moore or Thiollier leave their starting spots.

steps.title: Receive Black Syrup for Thiollier
steps.detail: Return to Moore after meeting Thiollier and speak with him to receive the Black Syrup to deliver to Thiollier.
steps.warning: Obtain before either NPC relocates or it becomes unobtainable this playthrough.

steps.title: Collect the Forager Brood Cookbooks
steps.detail: Find the six Forager Brood members scattered across the Land of Shadow to gather their cookbooks; one near the Church of the Crusade must be warmed with a Warming Stone or Sunwarmth Stone.
steps.location: Various (Scadu Altus, Gravesite Plain, Cerulean Coast)
steps.warning: After warming the frozen member, return to Moore for the final cookbook.

steps.title: Receive the final cookbook
steps.detail: Return to Moore's camp after helping the frozen Forager Brood member and speak with him to receive the last cookbook.
steps.warning: Losing Moore before this locks the remaining cookbooks permanently.

steps.title: Answer Moore after the charm breaks
steps.detail: After breaking Miquella's charm, Moore asks if you must be sad forever; reply 'put it behind you', 'remain sad forever', or 'I don't know'.
steps.warning: Choose only after securing all cookbooks and Black Syrup; 'remain sad forever' makes him die after the next rest, dropping his gear outside the Church of the Crusade.

steps.title: Defeat Moore's invasion
steps.detail: If you kill two friendly Forager Brood (Lesser Kindred of Rot), Moore invades; defeat him to claim his equipment.
steps.warning: If defeated his quest ends and any unobtained items are lost.

steps.title: Confront Moore at Enir-Ilim
steps.detail: If you told him to 'put it behind you', Moore joins the hostile NPC battle past the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom; defeat the group and loot his corpse.

summary: A silent wandering monk who challenges the Tarnished to honorable unarmed duels, teaching his martial art before turning up as a foe in the final NPC battle.
reward: Dryleaf Arts, Dane's Hat, Dane's Footwork

steps.title: Pick up the Monk's Missive
steps.detail: At the Highroad Cross grace collect the Monk's Missive and the 'May the Best Win' gesture, both needed to challenge Dane.

steps.title: Travel to Dryleaf Dane
steps.detail: Go to the easternmost cross on the New Cross Map to find Dane standing at Moorth Ruins; he does not move.

steps.title: Duel Dryleaf Dane
steps.detail: Use the 'May the Best Win' gesture on Dane to start the mini-boss duel; defeat him to learn his arts.
steps.warning: Breaking Miquella's charm does not affect this encounter.

steps.title: Collect the Dryleaf armor set
steps.detail: Reach the Ruins of Unte via the Shadow Keep ladder and teleport coffin to find the Dryleaf Robe, Dryleaf Arm Wraps and Dryleaf Cuissardes.

steps.title: Final battle at Enir-Ilim
steps.detail: In the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom NPC battle Dane is always hostile; defeat him and loot his corpse for his footwork art.
steps.warning: Dane always appears hostile here, so reconciliation is impossible.

summary: The High Priest of the Fingers at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr sends you to ring three Finger Ruin bells, a pilgrimage that ends with him casting off the Greater Will and transforming into a horror.
reward: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, Maternal Staff, Ymir's Bell Bearing, High Priest armor set

steps.title: Meet Count Ymir at the Cathedral
steps.detail: Speak with Count Ymir behind the closed doors of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and exhaust his dialogue; he also sells sorceries.

steps.title: Ring the bell at Finger Ruins of Rhia
steps.detail: Fast travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia, pass the Fingercreepers and ring the bell, then return to Ymir for a new map and Beloved Stardust; Jolán now appears at a pillar.
steps.location: Finger Ruins of Rhia, Cerulean Coast

steps.title: Ring the bell at Finger Ruins of Dheo
steps.detail: From the Shadow Keep Back Gate, perform the O Mother gesture at the altar to open the way to Scaduview, pass the two Tree Sentinels (Jolán can be summoned), ring the bell, and report back to Ymir.
steps.warning: The hidden altar requires the O Mother gesture, which is not signposted in-game.

steps.title: Descend to Finger Ruins of Miyr
steps.detail: Ask Ymir about the nature of the world, reload, and interact with his throne to reveal a rope ladder down to the Finger Ruins of Miyr.
steps.location: Cathedral of Manus Metyr throne room

steps.title: Survive Swordhand of Night Anna's invasion
steps.detail: In the underground ruins you are invaded by Swordhand of Night Anna; defeat her and grab the cookbook on the lower-left walkway.

steps.title: Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers
steps.detail: Ring the hanging bell via the Summoning Pool to enter the arena and defeat Metyr, the true Mother of Fingers, for a Remembrance and a large rune reward.
steps.warning: Defeating Metyr removes Jolán's gold summon signs at the Messmer, Tree Sentinels and Ghostflame Dragon fights.

steps.title: Defeat Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers
steps.detail: Return to the throne room and interact with the throne; after Swordhand of Night Jolán appears, Ymir transforms and must be defeated.
steps.location: Cathedral of Manus Metyr throne room

steps.title: Collect the High Priest gear and continue with Jolán
steps.detail: Take the High Priest armor set and Maternal Staff from the fight, grab the Cherishing Fingers in the western graveyard, then rest and speak with the slumped Jolán to continue her questline.

summary: A Blade of Twinned Knights bound to Count Ymir, Jolán and her lost partner Anna shadow his pilgrimage, and after the final duel you decide her fate with one of two irises.
reward: Swordhand of Night Jolán (Spirit Ash) or Sword of Night (Katana); optionally the Jolan and Anna combined Spirit Ash

steps.title: Meet Jolán at the Cathedral
steps.detail: After ringing the Finger Ruins of Rhia bell and reporting to Ymir, find Jolán leaning on a pillar in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak with her.
steps.warning: She appears against a pillar and is easy to miss.

steps.title: Speak after the second bell
steps.detail: After ringing the Finger Ruins of Dheo bell and reporting to Ymir, talk to Jolán again and exhaust her dialogue, then rest at the grace.

steps.title: Report Anna's invasion
steps.detail: Following Swordhand of Night Anna's invasion in the underground ruins, return and report the encounter to Jolán.

steps.title: Survive the Metyr progression
steps.detail: Continue Ymir's quest through the underground; Metyr, Mother of Fingers must be defeated to advance Jolán's story.
steps.warning: Defeating Metyr removes Jolán's summon signs at the Messmer, Tree Sentinels and Ghostflame Dragon fights.

steps.title: Fight Jolán alongside Count Ymir
steps.detail: Examine the empty throne after defeating Metyr; Swordhand of Night Jolán appears as part of the mandatory fight against the transformed Count Ymir.
steps.location: Cathedral of Manus Metyr throne room
steps.warning: This fight is mandatory and cannot be avoided.

steps.title: Choose an iris for Jolán
steps.detail: Rest, return, and approach Jolán sitting against the pillar; give her the Iris of Grace to receive her Spirit Ash, or the Iris of Occultation to receive the Sword of Night and end her life.
steps.warning: Only one iris can be given; Iris of Occultation kills Jolán and locks the Spirit Ash path.

steps.title: Unite Jolán and Anna
steps.detail: If you chose the Iris of Grace, travel to Rabbath's Rise behind Shaman Village in the Hinterlands, examine Anna's puppet, and usher Anna into the Spirit Ash to merge the partners.
steps.warning: Examine Anna's puppet before examining the throne to keep the full dialogue; this replaces the solo Jolán ash while keeping its level.
